name: Blind Date
source:
After reconciling their past, Simon and Dylan decide to meet again and see if the spark between them can become something more. But a storm threatens to ruin their perfect date! 

[From [url=https://apollostudios-lgbt.itch.io/blinddate]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在和解了他们的过去之后，西蒙和迪伦决定再次见面，看看他们之间的火花是否能产生更多火花。但一场暴风雨可能会毁掉他们完美的约会！

[来自[url=https://apollostudios-lgbt.itch.io/blinddate]Itch.io[/url]]
